subject: Brickstream: Access setup, minimal API key plan & invite cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brickstream.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Brickstream: Access setup, minimal API key plan & invite cadence

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our handoff from CS, I’m kicking off the access and API-seed plan so implementation can start next week. Goal here is to get a minimally-privileged dev surface for your engineers and a single admin key for initial setup so you can run smoke tests before we seed more keys into production projects.

Key proposal (attached: initial-api-seed-plan.pdf, invite-cadence.ods):
- Projects: brickstream-dev (sandbox), brickstream-prod (locked until order form accepted)
- Keys to seed initially: 1 admin key (for implementation), 1 scoped dev key (limited to embeddings + generate)
- Roles: Admin, Engineer, ReadOnly (we’ll provide role mapping YAML)
- Invite cadence: seed 2 admin users, 4 engineers in the first wave; invite-by-email + optional SSO linking later

Actions requested from your side:
1) Confirm the two kickoff windows below (we’ll schedule one 30-min kickoff): Tue 2028-05-16 10:00 PT or Wed 2028-05-17 11:00 PT
2) Tell us the security contact for audit/logging + whether you require SSO/SAML at first cut
3) Procurement contact so we can coordinate the order form (we’ll hold prod access until signed)

I’ll seed the sandbox keys once we confirm the kickoff slot and we receive the list of initial invitees (emails + role). Attached is a one-page plan and the invite cadence spreadsheet.

Ben
Ben Carter | Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments:
- initial-api-seed-plan.pdf (summary plan)
- invite-cadence.ods (proposed invite waves and owner assignments)

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brickstream.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brickstream.io, ops@brickstream.io
Date: 2028-05-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brickstream: Access setup, minimal API key plan & invite cadence

On Fri, May 11, 2028 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call yesterday...

Thanks Ben — this looks good and pragmatic. A couple quick items from our side:
- We do plan to enable SSO (Okta) but would like to postpone forcing SSO for the sandbox keys; we’ll want an email-invite flow for the first wave.
- Security wants to confirm audit log retention and whether we can restrict token issuance to specific IP ranges (is this configurable?).
- Procurement (cc’d) will handle the order form; please include a link to the commercial order so they can attach it to the PO.

Probable kickoff: Tue 5/16 10:00 PT works best. I’ll add Deepak (security) to the thread once I confirm.

— Samantha Liu
Head of Engineering, Brickstream
samantha.liu@brickstream.io | +1 212-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brickstream.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brickstream: Access setup, minimal API key plan & invite cadence

Great — thanks for the quick turn. Short answers and next steps below.

SSO: ok to postpone SSO for sandbox keys. We’ll provide both email-invite and SSO enablement flows; SSO can be enforced later without re-issuing existing scoped keys.

Audit logs / IP restrictions:
- Audit logs: Redwood stores per-request metadata (api_key_id, route, model, latency) and can retain logs per-account for configurable retention windows. Default is 90 days; we can extend for enterprise plans.
- IP allowlist: yes, we support org-level IP allowlist for key issuance and route-level network policies. We’ll document the process in the kickoff.

Practical seeding plan (we will execute after kickoff + signed order form):
1) Create projects: brickstream-dev (sandbox), brickstream-prod (locked).
2) Seed keys into brickstream-dev:
   - admin_key_dev (admin privileges, rotate after handoff)
   - dev_key_scoped (generate + embeddings only, rate limit 600 rpm)
3) Invite flow: we will send email invites (monica will own the invites) and mark initial invites to the Engineer role.
4) Production access: we will keep brickstream-prod in a restricted state until we’ve received the signed order form and procurement confirmation. On sign, we’ll create prod_api_key_admin and seed per your seat requirements.

Attachments I’m adding now:
- sandbox-keys-template.csv (format we’ll use to seed user/key pairs)

Links: onboarding checklist (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding-checklist) and your HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/8347).

If that looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue 5/16 10:00 PT and we’ll execute the initial seed during that meeting. Monica — could you please take the invite-owner action?

Thanks,
Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brickstream.io>
Date: 2028-05-11T13:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brickstream: Access setup, minimal API key plan & invite cadence

Scheduling note: I’ll set a 30-min kickoff for Tue 2028-05-16 10:00 PT and add the Zoom link. I’ll also send the sandbox-keys-template.csv to Samantha so they can pre-fill the invite list (emails + role column).

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brickstream.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brickstream.io, Deepak Sharma <deepak@brickstream.io>
Date: 2028-05-11T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brickstream: Access setup, minimal API key plan & invite cadence

Thanks Ben and Monica — Tue 10:00 PT confirmed. I’ve looped in Deepak (security) and procurement; procurement will expect the order form link and net-30 PO instructions.

Two asks for the kickoff deck: please include a single slide that spells out
- what telemetry we retain and for how long
- how key rotation will work during the first 30 days
- contact for emergency key revocation

We’ll aim to have the initial invite list back to you by EOD Mon 5/15. See you on Tue.

— Samantha
Head of Engineering, Brickstream
